decision_rule: Admit only if outcome-aware coupling preserves M98 hidden-envelope lift and makes reset/zero-response/wrong-history ablations worse on outcome-sensitive states.
failure_criteria: fixed-batch action divergence improves without closed-loop behavior degradation under ablation
hidden-envelope braking or lateral lift regresses versus M98
normal behavior regresses versus M62 or M98
objective labels hidden physics or oracle feasibility as actor inputs
hypothesis: History dependence must be trained on outcome-sensitive snippets; action-distance-only objectives are too weak because they can separate actions on fixed batches without making recurrent history causally useful in closed-loop behavior.
success_criteria: constructs a snippet or corpus where normal history beats reset or zero-response in outcome
uses only deployable actor observations and training-time outcome labels
reset, zero-response, delayed-history, or wrong-history ablations degrade success or clearance
